title.narrative: Collective Action for Rights realisation in extractives Industry (CLARITY)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is that marginalised groups, including women, youth and PWD, realise their rights to full and equal economic participation in sustainable livelihoods within the extractive sector in Mara and Geita regions of TanzaniaThe specific objectives are:(1)Strengthened human rights and business responsive due diligence mechanisms that hold duty bearers to account and increase access to justice in the extractive sector, delivered to marginalised groups by CSOs, unions
